mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plugin_account WHERE plugin_id = #{pluginId} ORDER BY account_id
SELECT * FROM plugin_account WHERE plugin_id = #{pluginId} AND enabled = TRUE ORDER BY account_id
SELECT * FROM plugin_account WHERE plugin_id = #{pluginId} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND enabled = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plugin_account (plugin_id, account_id, display_name, account_json, enabled) VALUES (#{pluginId}, #{accountId}, #{displayName}, CAST(#{accountJson} AS JSON), #{enabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = VALUES(display_name), account_json = VALUES(account_json), enabled = VALUES(enabled), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM plugin_account WHERE plugin_id = #{pluginId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
